fact: Fact Management reconciles the facts supplied for a task against the project facts used in that task.

Task entry opens Fact Management. The main conversation compares the taskbook facts with the local register using taskbook_query_facts and reports the comparison. On a pass the plugin prepares the current task view and starts Design.
source: Maintainer decision: entry compares taskbook and local facts | index.ts | prompts/fact-management.md

fact: Fact Management pauses for the user when a supplied fact overlaps a registered fact and the requested update or separate scope is unclear.
Fact Management tags supplied facts with the active taskbook's label so later stages can distinguish them from project background.
Fact Management uses the executing Pi session’s model and thinking level.
After the lead signs the current delivery revision, final registration commits the taskbook fact operations together with the draft facts marked keep in that review.
After the user selects facts, destination tables, and a work branch, prepare-facts writes a private migration input for normal task entry and signed fact registration.
